name: darrow-ticket-to-pr
description: Delegate one explicit ticket-to-PR delivery, including required same-PR reviewer evidence

interface.shortDescription: Deliver one ticket as one pull request
interface.longDescription: Ticket to PR preserves one ticket-delivery authority envelope and delegates it once to adaptive-delivery, including at most one candidate-bound reviewer-evidence publication when the ticket or verification contract requires it.
defaultPrompt: Use $ticket-to-pr to deliver this ticket as one verified pull request.
